C1273.title: Over 4,300 Spoofed FIFA Domains Target World Cup Fans
C1273.summary: Ahead of the 2026 World Cup, cybersecurity data reveals more than 4,300 counterfeit FIFA domains have been identified. FortiGuard Labs reported that over 13,000 World Cup-themed domains were registered between January and May this year, with approximately 8.8% flagged as malicious or suspicious.
